regions.summary: Code: AddTime, SubTime, IncScore, AddScoreBonus, SubScoreBonus, AddPocketedSumToScore, AddScoreToTotal, BallPointValue, CheckTargetScore, FindLowestScore, CheckMatchTarget, SetMatchOverFlag, SelectLeader, ReachedScore20, ReachedScore8, ScoreReachedTarget, CountActiveBalls, EndOfMatch, NoOp

units.name: AddTime
units.summary: Adds time (Tmp06/Tmp08) to the player clocks.

units.name: SubTime
units.summary: Subtracts time from the player clocks.

units.name: IncScore
units.summary: Adds one point to the current player.

units.name: AddScoreBonus
units.summary: Adds a bonus to the current player's score.

units.name: SubScoreBonus
units.summary: Subtracts a penalty from the current player's score.

units.name: AddPocketedSumToScore
units.summary: Adds PocketedBallSum (the ball numbers pocketed by this shot) to the current player's score.

units.name: AddScoreToTotal
units.summary: Adds the current player's score to PlayerTotalScore (the TOTAL column of the intermission scoreboard).

units.name: BallPointValue
units.summary: Computes the point value of the pocketed balls.

units.name: CheckTargetScore
units.summary: Checks whether a player reached the target score.

units.name: FindLowestScore
units.summary: Finds the player with the lowest PlayerScore (index in Tmp08, score in Ptr04), calling SetMatchOverFlag whenever a new minimum is found.

units.name: CheckMatchTarget
units.summary: Checks the match target for the game type (GameTypeTable2).

units.name: SetMatchOverFlag
units.summary: Sets MatchOverFlag (match over).

units.name: SelectLeader
units.summary: Makes the player with the higher score current.

units.name: ReachedScore20
units.summary: Sets TargetScore to 20 and falls into ScoreReachedTarget.

units.name: ReachedScore8
units.summary: Sets TargetScore to 8 and falls into ScoreReachedTarget.

units.name: ScoreReachedTarget
units.summary: Returns A = $FF (Z clear) when the current player's PlayerScore is at least TargetScore and not negative, else A = 0 (Z set).

units.name: CountActiveBalls
units.summary: Counts object balls on the table (BallState bit5) into Tmp02.

units.name: EndOfMatch
units.summary: Runs after every finished game: from RecordGameWin, from EliminateShooter when one player is left, and after a tied game (MSG_TIED_REPLAY).

units.name: NoOp
units.summary: Empty routine (rts).

units.name: BallInPocketZone (part)
units.summary: Tests ball Y's position against the pocket coordinate thresholds.

units.name: PredictCushionContact
units.summary: Predicts ball X's next contact with the table edges (cushions/pocket jaws) from the edge tables; only balls with spin/motion state bits 6-7 set take the full path.

units.name: ContactTimeToEdge
units.summary: Computes the time for ball X to reach table edge segment A (tables $9937/$99C7/$9A57/$9AE7).

units.name: MulFixedMid
units.summary: Fixed-point helper around MulSigned16 returning the middle product bytes in $4E/$4F.

units.name: ResolveEdgeContact
units.summary: Resolves a cushion-edge contact for ball Y: a pocket edge (ContactKind 1) drops the ball (BallState low bits cleared); otherwise the velocity is reflected about the edge normal.

units.name: ReflectVelocity
units.summary: Applies EdgeDamp to both velocity components of ball Y.

units.name: EdgeDamp
units.summary: Damps a signed velocity component in Tmp02/03.

units.name: PredictPointContact
units.summary: Predicts when ball X will touch the fixed point A of the PocketPointX/Y table (cushion nose / pocket jaw corners): the same along/perpendicular projection method as PredictPairContact with the point as a stationary partner and a one-ball radius; stores the time in the contact tables when it is the e

units.name: ResolvePointContact
units.summary: Bounce off the corner point stored in BallContact+1: velocity is reflected about the normal from the point to the ball centre (v - 2(v.n)n, scaled), then replay, rule counters, roll and damping are updated.

units.name: CountRuleEvent
units.summary: When FirstBallHit is set (the cue ball has already hit something), counts the event in RailHitCount and sets bit (Y/2) of RailBallMask for ball Y.

phase1.evidence: L-006 one-byte alternate-entry prologue: $DE1C pha falls into VramBufFlushNow ($DE1D). Stack contract: VramBufFlushNow pushes 2 bytes (X, Y) and pulls 3 (Y, X, A) before rts; both branch-in users (VramBufCommit, VramBufWaitEmpty) execute pha first, so a direct entry needs exactly one preceding pha, which is this byte (analysis/redirect/r2-q1/notes.md). No reference to $DE1C found (xref-lowconf.json): reachability unknown, not claimed. Metadata refreshed in round 3 (L-009).
